2 design examples

01 / Commercial · Restroom

Under the sink
Supplied space · Edited design concept

A place for the
restroom supplies.

A cabinet concept that gives paper goods and cleaning supplies their own places beneath the sink.

The problem
Supplies collect on the floor around exposed plumbing, with no separate places to store them.
The change
This concept adds shelving and divided pull-out trays on either side of the central pipe.
The aim
Keep supplies grouped and visible, with less to move when looking for something.

02 / Residential · Bathroom

Under the sink
Illustrative design concept

More room in the
cabinet you have.

An under-sink shelving concept that makes space above the cabinet floor useful.

The problem
Towels, bottles, and baskets share one crowded surface while the space above sits empty.
The change
This concept adds shelves beside the plumbing and a central surround for a cleaner interior.
The aim
Separate everyday essentials across storage levels so each group has a place to return to.
Plan a similar space ↗

Concept images show possible layouts. Final dimensions, materials, plumbing access, and suitability need to be reviewed for the actual space.
